plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: A deciduous ornamental tree covered in clouds of pale pink-white, five-petaled blossoms that appear before the leaves emerge. It is the iconic cherry tree of Japanese hanami celebrations and lines streets, parks and rivers across temperate Asia, Europe and North America.
plants.location: Japan (Tokyo, Kyoto), Washington D.C. USA, Korea, and temperate parks worldwide
plants.funFact: The Yoshino cherry is a clonal cultivar, so most trees in a region bloom almost simultaneously, and the Japan Meteorological Agency tracks the 'cherry blossom front' as it moves north each spring.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: A bulbous perennial with trumpet-shaped yellow flowers with paler yellow outer petals, rising above blue-green strap-like leaves. It grows in woodlands and meadows in western Europe and is widely cultivated in gardens.
plants.location: Western Europe (UK, France, Spain), naturalized in North America and cultivated in temperate gardens worldwide
plants.funFact: Daffodils contain the alkaloid lycorine, which makes them toxic to most grazing animals and even to other flowers if cut stems are placed together in a vase.

plants.name: Magnolia stellata
plants.description: A compact deciduous shrub or small tree bearing fragrant, star-shaped flowers with many narrow strap-like tepals. The blooms open on bare branches in early spring and can be damaged by late frosts.
plants.location: Native to Japan, widely grown in the northeastern United States, Europe and temperate Asia
plants.funFact: Magnolias are among the most ancient flowering plants, evolving before bees existed, which is why their sturdy flowers are thought to have evolved to be pollinated by beetles.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: A tall subtropical tree with fern-like leaves that erupts in masses of lavender-blue trumpet-shaped flowers. In the Southern Hemisphere, early autumn can bring a late or repeat bloom, and the fallen petals carpet streets in purple.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring in the Northern Hemisphere tropics (March to May); main bloom October to December in the Southern Hemisphere with occasional autumn flowering
plants.location: Native to South America (Argentina, Bolivia); planted in Mexico, India, Pretoria South Africa, and Australia
plants.funFact: Pretoria is nicknamed the 'Jacaranda City' because of its roughly 70,000 jacaranda trees that turn the city purple.
